+function bestLiveBlockForAttraction(d,x){
+ const exact=(d.blocks||[]).findIndex(b=>blockPark(d,b)===x.park&&normalizeAreaForPark(b.area,x.park)===normalizeAreaForPark(x.area,x.park));
+ if(exact>=0)return exact;
+ const same=(d.blocks||[]).findIndex(b=>blockPark(d,b)===x.park);
+ return same>=0?same:0;
+}
+function addLiveSuggestion(id){
+ if(!canEditPlanner())return;const x=BY_ID[id],d=DAYS[currentDay];if(!x||!d)return;const bi=bestLiveBlockForAttraction(d,x),b=d.blocks[bi];b.ids=b.ids||[];if(!b.ids.includes(id))b.ids.push(id);queuePlannerSave();renderAll();
+}
+function liveAllCandidates(d,park){
+ const plannedMap=new Map(plannedIdsForPark(d,park).map(o=>[o.id,o]));
+ if(liveRouteMode==='plan')return [...plannedMap.values()].map(o=>({...o,planned:true}));
+ const out=[];
+ Object.values(BY_ID).forEach(x=>{
+  if(!x||x.park!==park||x.kind==='show')return;
+  if(status(x.id,currentDay)==='done'||status(x.id,currentDay)==='skip')return;
+  if(liveFocusArea&&normalizeAreaForPark(x.area,park)!==normalizeAreaForPark(liveFocusArea,park))return;
+  const p=plannedMap.get(x.id);out.push(p?{...p,planned:true}:{id:x.id,bi:bestLiveBlockForAttraction(d,x),ii:999,x,planned:false});
+ });
+ return out;
+}
+function llNextSuggestion(d,park){
+ const rows=plannedIdsForPark(d,park).filter(o=>status(o.id,currentDay)!=='done'&&llEligibility(o.x)).filter(o=>{const p=llPlan(o.id);return p.state!=='booked'&&p.state!=='redeemed'});
+ if(!rows.length)return null;const here=currentLocationLive(park);
+ rows.forEach((o,i)=>{const l=liveByName(park,o.x.name),walk=liveWalkMinutes(here,l),wait=l?.standby??35,pri=o.x.ll==='Lightning Lane priority'?0:25;o._llscore=pri+wait*.7+(walk??8)+i*2;o._live=l;o._walk=walk});
+ rows.sort((a,b)=>a._llscore-b._llscore);return rows[0];
+}
+function renderLLSuggestion(d,park){const s=llNextSuggestion(d,park);if(!s)return'';return `<div class="llSuggest"><b>Next Lightning Lane to look for: ${escAttr(s.x.name)}</b><div class="small">Fits your current plan${s._walk!=null?` · about ${s._walk} min from your location`:''}. Check actual availability in My Disney Experience.</div><div class="liveHeroRow"><a class="tinyAction" href="https://disneyworld.app.link/MyDisneyExperienceEN-US" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Check in Disney app</a>${canEditPlanner()?`<button class="tinyAction" onclick="openQuickSheet('attraction',${s.bi},'${s.id}')">Track it</button>`:''}</div></div>`}

+let liveDayCache={};let liveDayPark='';let liveDayLoading=false;
+function dateKeyLocal(){const d=new Date();return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`}
+function isSelectedDayToday(){return DAYS[currentDay]?.date===dateKeyLocal()}
+function canonicalParkClient(p){if(/magic kingdom/i.test(p))return'Magic Kingdom';if(/epcot/i.test(p))return'EPCOT';if(/hollywood/i.test(p))return'Disney’s Hollywood Studios';if(/animal kingdom/i.test(p))return'Disney’s Animal Kingdom';return''}
+async function loadLiveDayData(park,force=false){
+ park=canonicalParkClient(park);if(!park||!plannerConnected)return null;const cached=liveDayCache[park];if(!force&&cached&&Date.now()-(cached._clientFetched||0)<240000)return cached;
+ liveDayLoading=true;renderToday();try{const p=await plannerLiveRequest(park);p._clientFetched=Date.now();liveDayCache[park]=p;return p}catch(e){console.warn(e);liveDayCache[park]={ok:false,error:String(e.message||e),_clientFetched:Date.now()};return liveDayCache[park]}finally{liveDayLoading=false;renderToday()}
+}
+function liveByName(park,name){const p=liveDayCache[park];if(!p||!Array.isArray(p.live))return null;const n=normName(name);return p.live.find(x=>normName(x.name)===n)||p.live.find(x=>normName(x.name).includes(n)||n.includes(normName(x.name)))||null}
+function waitClass(w,status){if(status&&status!=='OPERATING')return'closed';if(w==null)return'';if(w<=25)return'low';if(w<=50)return'med';return'high'}
